name: Frozen Past
source:
Frozen Past is set in the near future, where our hero wakes up with no memory of his past.

His relatives seem reluctant to enlighten him, and our amnesiac hero will have to go through many obstacles to recover his lost life.

But is it worth it?

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/leonave]Patreon[/url]]
